description: Control of the enterprise CA object or its hosting computer, enabling arbitrary PKI compromise.

telemetry.detail: Logon to the CA host for hands-on-CA actions (config edits, key access).
Certificate Services received a certificate request (on the CA).
Certificate Services issued a certificate (on the CA).
PKINIT TGT request using the issued certificate - certificate-logon anomaly.
Administrative access to a CA host is high-value and frequently monitored; CA service/config changes are high-fidelity.

prerequisite_privilege: Control of the CA object, or admin on the CA hosting computer
abuse_primitive: Reconfigure the CA (enable SAN, issue as anyone) or extract the CA private key for offline forging.
notes: Owning the CA is close to game-over and is a monitored asset. CA private key theft enables silent forging afterward, shifting noise to first access.
